description:
Send an email to the verified mailboxes of the account you're acting for.

The SMTP gateway delivers to your verified address for an individual account, or to every active team member's verified address for a team. An optional account email preference receives an additional copy through an SMTP-input service; that service can relay mail or convert it to HTTP. Formatting and attachments remain intact on the default email delivery.

Authenticate to the SMTP gateway with username `email` and your UnitySVC API key. The sender's envelope recipients do not redirect the default mailbox delivery. Configure an email preference on the account when you want an additional delivery.
name: email

payout_price.description: No platform commission — delivers to account member mailboxes and the configured email service

summary: Send email to verified account member mailboxes and an optional additional delivery service.
